description: This PHP file initializes certain global variables, checks for required request parameters (module, action, record), sanitizes them, retrieves the corresponding entity object, and then dynamically includes an action script based on the module and action. It appears to serve as a controller or entry point for PDF-related functionality in the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: $entity
classes.description: A variable holding the name of the entity class associated with the current module, retrieved from the global beanList. It is used to instantiate a new object of that class.

methods.name: retrieve()
methods.description: Method called on the focus object to load data for the specified record.
